entities.name: RRC connection establishment
entities.description: Procedure that establishes SRB1 and occurs before NG connection establishment and AS security activation.

entities.name: Initial AS security activation
entities.description: Procedure that activates both ciphering and integrity protection for AS security after receiving UE context from 5GC.

entities.name: RRC connection release
entities.description: Procedure normally initiated by network to release RRC connection, potentially redirecting UE to another frequency.

entities.name: RRC connection suspension
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network where UE stores UE Inactive AS context and transitions to RRC_INACTIVE state.

entities.name: RRC connection resumption
entities.description: Procedure initiated by upper layers or RRC layer to resume suspended RRC connection, re-activating security and re-establishing bearers.

entities.name: Signalling Radio Bearer 1
entities.description: First signalling radio bearer established during RRC connection establishment.

entities.name: Signalling Radio Bearer 2
entities.description: Second signalling radio bearer that must be configured with at least one DRB or multicast MRB.

entities.name: AS security
entities.description: Access Stratum security comprising both integrity protection and ciphering.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE stores context and can perform SDT while maintaining connection suspension.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: Active RRC connection state with full radio bearer establishment.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state with no active connection, entered after connection release.

entities.name: Timer T319a
entities.description: Timer running during SDT in RRC_INACTIVE state for data and signalling transmission.

entities.name: Small Data Transmission configuration
entities.description: Configuration allowing data and signalling transmission while UE remains in RRC_INACTIVE state.

relations.description: RRC connection establishment procedure establishes SRB1
Initial AS security activation procedure activates both integrity protection and ciphering
RRC connection suspension causes UE to transit to RRC_INACTIVE state
Successful RRC connection resumption sends UE to RRC_CONNECTED state
RRC connection resume procedure re-activates AS security
SDT configuration starts timer T319a for data transmission in RRC_INACTIVE
RRC connection release sends UE to RRC_IDLE state
SRB2 establishment requires both integrity protection and ciphering
